critical_code_review_comments: routes_workspace.py (~60 LOC) is a single endpoint and is clean and correct: scoped by need('teacher.workspace') so admin/parent 403 by default; teacher doc lookup via (school_id, user_id); timetable grid filtered by {teacher_id, day=today.isoweekday()}; period start/end mapped via a dict for O(1) lookup.

To-do construction correctly separates class-teacher sections (used for attendance to-dos) from the broader teacher_assignments set (used for diary + exam marks eligibility). taught_today is derived from the schedule, so diary to-dos only appear for sections actually taught today — matches the Module 7 spec.

Diary dedupe uses db.diary.distinct('section_id', {...created_by:ctx.user_id, deleted:{$ne:true}}); exam pending counter iterates db.exams(status='marks_open', section_ids∈my_sections) and skips (section,subject) pairs where exam_marks already exists OR teacher is neither assigned-for-subject nor class-teacher for that section — same gating as PUT /exams/{eid}/marks.

Response shape matches the pytest invariant and the frontend WS type exactly: {date,weekday,schedule[*{period,start,end,section_id,section_label,subject_name,room}],todo[*{kind,section_id?,title}],counts{periods_today,homework_due_today,homework_drafts,marks_sheets_pending,pending_leave,diary_written_today}} — no mongo _id leaks.

teacher-workspace.tsx wires useFocusEffect(()=>refetch(),[refetch]) so returning from attendance/diary/homework/exams refetches /teacher/workspace — observed working on live preview (Class 5-A attendance to-do cleared on return). Nothing else was coupled into state; the only data source is the useQuery, so stale updates aren't possible.

The row key for todo uses `${kind}-${section_id ?? i}` which is stable across refetches for the two non-section kinds (homework_drafts, marks) because they appear at most once each in the server response — safe.
today.tsx RefreshControl triggers both q.refetch() (useTeacherDash) and ws.refetch() on pull-to-refresh, keeping the stat cards and workspace in sync.

Minor nit (not blocking): routes_workspace.py imports bson via __import__('bson') inside the labels dict comprehension. Hoisting to a top-level `from bson import ObjectId` would be cleaner but has no runtime impact.

context_for_next_testing_agent: M2 Module 7 (Teacher Workspace) is production-ready. Single endpoint under /api: GET /teacher/workspace (need=teacher.workspace, admin/parent 403). Response: {date, weekday, schedule[], todo[], counts{...}}. Schedule items contain {day,period,section_id,section_label,subject_id,subject_name,teacher_id,teacher_name,room,start,end}. Todo kinds: 'attendance' (per class-teacher section not yet marked for the day), 'diary' (per section taught today without a diary entry by this user), 'homework_drafts' (singleton, count=draft HW by this user), 'marks' (singleton, count=exam section×subject sheets this teacher must enter that are empty). Frontend testIDs: ws-schedule-card, ws-periods-count, ws-period-<n>, ws-todo-card, ws-todo-count, ws-todo-<kind>-<sectionId|all>, ws-todo-empty, ws-hw-due. Component: /app/frontend/src/components/teacher-workspace.tsx; mounted via TeacherWorkspace inside /app/frontend/app/(teacher)/today.tsx. Focus refetch wired through useFocusEffect+useQuery, verified clearing attendance todo after submit. Demo linkage used for E2E: teacher@sunrise.demo (Neha Kulkarni) teaches English in Class 1-A on day 5 (6 periods) and is class-teacher for Class 1-A (6ad09c1b1aad3ba7d4fb3a15) and Class 5-A (6ad09c1b1aad3ba7d4fb3ab9).
